title: I paid$12
text: I paid$12. Adequate for sucking up the crumbs from cat treats and cleaning the cat tree.  For $12 you can't beat it but you do get what you pay for. But I'm happy with it.

product_metadata.title: Usin Handheld Vacuum Cordless, Powerful Suction Dust Buster, USB Rechargeable Wireless Car Vacuum, Mini Hand Vac, Portable Lightweight Wet Dry Couch Cleaner for Pet Hair Home Car Office Cleaning
features: 【6k Pa Suction for Thorough Cleaning with Lower Noise】Equipped with a 120W high speed bronze motor delivering powerful suction up to 6000 Pa, the dust buster cordless rechargeable can easily pick up dust, pet hair, crumbs and debris with noise less than 65 dB.

【Cordless, Portable and Lightweight】Cord-free! Hassle-free! Weighing just 1.1 lbs, you can take the cordless lightweight portable vacuum to anywhere you want to clean up messes without grappling with tangled cords or heavy weight.

【Quick Charge and Long Runtime】 With 2000 mAh high capacity lithium batteries, the wireless hand vacuum can be fully charged in 2-3 hours and runs up to 25 minutes. You can easily charge the small handheld vacuum with the included USB charging cable in your home or in the car.

【Crevice and Brush Nozzles for Wet/Dry Clean】The cordless vacuum comes with crevice and brush nozzles for cleaning spilled liquids like milk and dry messes like dust. The trash container with large capacity of 7.1 oz is translucent and you can easily detach and empty it when necessary. The HEPA filter which traps particles is washable and reusable.

【Sleek Design and Easy to Store】With sleek design, the mini vacuum better matches the surroundings it places at home or office. Small in size, it can be stored in the glove box, cup holder or door compartment in car.
description: Usin cordless handheld vacuum cleaner uses advanced technology for hassle-free operation and ensures more effortless cleaning of the interior of your house and car. All the unwanted dirt, dust, pet hair and other allergens can be removed from  your home or car with the use of our hand cleaner to make your space look much nicer.
Features of Usin Wireless Portable Vacuum:

Suction: Up to 6K Pa with a high performance motor  Fast USB Charging: 2-3 hours  Longer runtime: 25 minutes  Lightweight: Weighing 1.1 pounds for great maneuverability and easy cleaning  Attachments: Crevice tool and brush attachment for tight space and hard-to-reach areas  For Wet/Dry Use: Sucking wet and dry messes like spilled coffee and pet hair  Design: Sleek design adding luxury to your home  Storage: Small and easy to store in your car and home  Dust Cup: 7.1 oz large capacity detachable and washable  HEPA Filter: Washable and reusable
1 x Hand Held Vacuum  1 x Crevice Nozzle  1 x Brush Nozzle  1 x Aux Connector  1 x USB Cable  1 x User Manual

1.Please fully charge it before first use for about 3 hours. The indicator light will change from red to green when fully charged.  2.Do not switch on or use it while charging.  3.It is recommended the vacuum be charged every two weeks, even if you are not using it.  4.For better continuous suction power, it’s recommended the HEPA filter be washed with water every time after use or when it’s blocked. Air dry the HEPA filter before installation. Do not use it when it’s wet.  5.Do not block the suction opening when the vacuum is working.

details.Included Components: Nozzle, USB Charging Cable, HEPA Filter, Crevice tool, Brush
